protocol.seedRule: 2183 + number of previously won encounters, matching the game UI
protocol.purchases: Only earned credits; rifle, shield and armor, in that order, up to five levels; no optional caches or medigel purchases.
protocol.squad: Starting story squad; Garrus and Tali after Citadel; Garrus and Liara after Therum except Adept and Vanguard.
protocol.healthBetweenEncounters: actorFor restores full health and shields at each encounter, matching current game behavior; medigel persists.
protocol.progression: Unlocks, ordered encounter gates, recruitment, explicit choices and save/import round trips are checked.
protocol.baseline: Previous balance parameters restored in memory; all other current engine logic and player policy remain identical.
limits: One deterministic seed sequence and one campaign route per class.
Instant automated decisions in Wait mode; not a human usability or Active mode test.
Systematic upgrades and trained-power usage; casual play can be harder.
This is a regression and calibration report, not final human playtest balancing.
